title: coleus englerastrum
intro: Coleus englerastrum, commonly known as Cuban coleus or "blood root," is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Coleus englerastrum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Coleus englerastrum on human health and its potential applications in traditional medicine.
